gladiator.profile: Crit 71% overall, 52% on skills without guaranteed crits; 80% front / 11% back hits; doubles 21%.

Cogni.why: Max Attack (Heroic 10–20) raises your weapon's top roll, which Weapon Damage Boost then multiplies: the best flat attack stat per point in Kanon's formula. Attack Bonus (8–16) is next; PvE Attack (10–20) ties it on bosses and also works on trash, Boss Attack only on bosses. Front/Back Attack and Critical Attack only count from one side or on crits. No damage stat can roll here (all 45–60 options are HP, MP, defense or crit resist). HP increase is the only one worth keeping; never spend a lock on this line. Global builds: HP increase 88%, Defense Bonus 2%, MP 2%.

Keep whatever unlocked rolls give on the other lines.
